model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the negative log probability for per-specialty terms across six medical specialties—Cardio, Gastro, Infect, Neuro, Obstetrics, and Pediatrics—comparing the performance of a Mistralv0.2-Base model against models fine-tuned on each respective specialty. The horizontal axis, labeled “Per-specialty terms,” lists the six specialties in alphabetical order from left to right. The vertical axis, labeled “Negative log probability,” is scaled linearly from -22 to -27, with tick marks at regular intervals of one unit. Each specialty has a group of six bars, each representing one of the six fine-tuned models (Cardio, Gastro, Infect, Neuro, Obstetrics, Pediatrics), distinguished by color: light beige for Cardio, light orange for Gastro, medium orange for Infect, dark orange for Neuro, brown for Obstetrics, and dark brown for Pediatrics. The base model, Mistralv0.2-Base, is represented by a single light blue bar in each group. The bars are sorted within each group by descending height (i.e., ascending negative log probability value), with the base model bar consistently being the tallest (least negative) in each group. The values range from approximately -26.5 for the base model in Cardio to around -27.2 for the Pediatrics fine-tuned model in the same group, indicating that the base model assigns higher probability to terms in all specialties compared to the fine-tuned models.
